ticket.title: Add top-level research --version option
ticket.requestText:
Add a top-level `research --version` option that prints the package version and exits successfully without requiring configuration, network access, or state files. Add focused tests and preserve existing commands.

Done means:
`research --version` prints the package version and exits with status 0 without configuration, network access, or state files. Focused tests cover this behavior, and existing commands retain their behavior.
